name: DataSeal
priceLabel: Not stated on official site — no price appears on DataSeal's homepage, FAQ or signup pages; its funnel starts with a free scan
priceNote: No price or dollar amount appears on DataSeal's homepage or in its current FAQ answers; its funnel starts with a free scan. The current FAQ (dataseal.io/faq, which redirects to the homepage FAQ section) states no prices and no annual-upgrade wording. Do not use any DataSeal price from reviews — none could be verified on dataseal.io.
brokerCountLabel: "200+" — dataseal.io/ homepage: '200+ people search sites and brokers' (used in this comparison as the stated claim). Its list page, dataseal.io/sites-we-cover, also headlines '200+ sites' and names 218 sites across 3 pages (100 + 100 + 18) — the 218 names are what the Broker table uses
rescanLabel: "Continuously monitors the internet" for re-appearing data — no interval stated

features.label: Broker scan
features.norton: Yes — scans supported people-search & data broker sites and shows which have your data
features.rival: Yes — free scan ('Run a free scan to discover which data brokers, breaches, and online sources may be exposing your information')

features.label: Automated removal included
features.norton: No — included Privacy Monitor is manual opt-out. Automated removal only with Privacy Monitor Assistant add-on, $109.99/yr or $12.99/mo
features.rival: Yes — 'Automated Data Removal' included in its one subscription

features.label: Broker count stated
features.norton: Page by page on norton.com — the Privacy Monitor Assistant product page (us.norton.com/products/privacy-monitor-assistant) says 'over 2,000' data broker sites; the Privacy Monitor feature page (us.norton.com/feature/privacy-monitor) says 'over 200'; the support list names sites individually with no total. Used in this comparison: 'over 2,000' from the Assistant product page on the main site — the Assistant is the removal product. No staging page is used as a source anywhere in this comparison
features.note: Page by page — '200+' on dataseal.io/ (homepage) and in the headline of dataseal.io/sites-we-cover (used in this comparison as the stated claim). That list page names 218 sites across 3 pages (100 on page 1, 100 on page 2, 18 on page 3), counted 5 Nov 2026 — the 218 names are the Broker table; no names beyond those 218 are claimed.
features.rival: "200+" on dataseal.io/ homepage and on its list page headline — its list page (dataseal.io/sites-we-cover) names 218 sites across 3 pages

features.label: Rescan speed
features.norton: Every 90 days (Privacy Monitor Assistant); Privacy Monitor scan re-run every 3 months
features.rival: "Continuously monitors the internet to ensure your data does not reappear" — no interval stated

features.label: Custom removal requests
features.norton: Offered via Reputation Defender executive/corporate products only (quote-led, 'when possible', no published price, no consumer product): ExecutivePrivacy — “Custom removal requests, when possible”; Total Radius — “Custom Data Removals”; VIP Services — “Deep Web privacy protection, including custom removal requests”. No Norton consumer product offers custom removals — Privacy Monitor Assistant covers its supported broker list only

features.label: Google results removal
features.norton: Yes — via Reputation Defender (separate purchase, reputationdefender.com): “Push negative content or misleading search results down to pages where virtually nobody will ever see them”; its FAQ: “in certain cases online content in your search results can be permanently deleted”. Reputation Defender suppresses negative content in search results and deletes content where possible — it does not make de-indexing requests to Google

features.label: Removal proof
features.norton: Results list + opt-out tracking; email once a batch of opt-outs has been sent. Screenshots: Not stated on official site
features.rival: Yes — dashboard shows sites 'in progress', with 'completed removals', and 'actively being monitored for re-listing' (FAQ: 'How do I track my information removal progress?')

features.label: Tracker & cookie blocking
features.norton: Yes — Tracker & Cookie Blocking (support). Full ad blocking: Not stated on official site ('limit targeted ads')
features.rival: Not stated on official site — removal only; its anti-exposure feature is virtual identities, not tracker blocking

features.label: Fingerprint protection
features.norton: "Disguise your digital fingerprint automatically each time you browse" — support: anti-fingerprinting will 'return dummy data' to websites

features.label: Email aliases + tracker blocking
features.norton: Yes — create unlimited email aliases (AntiTrack Private Email) and block hidden email trackers
features.rival: Aliases: Yes — 'unlimited virtual emails' plus a private SMS number. Email tracker blocking: Not stated on official site

features.label: App / OS-level protection
features.norton: Yes — Windows OS Tracker Blocking: blocks tracking activities and targeted ads by the Windows operating system (support)

features.label: Tracking dashboard
features.norton: Yes — Tracking Dashboard shows real-time blocked trackers, ranked by level of concern / risk
features.rival: No tracking dashboard — removal dashboard only

tiers.highlight: Automated removal from '200+' sites claimed · dashboard Found / Pending / Removed / Verified · unlimited virtual emails + private SMS number · $1M cover
tiers.name: DataSeal subscription (only plan described)
tiers.note: Only one subscription is described — no named tiers. Page by page: dataseal.io/ claims '200+'; dataseal.io/sites-we-cover headlines '200+ sites' but prints 100 named cards.
tiers.priceLabel: No price published on official site — free scan first, then a prorated annual upgrade (amount unstated)

refs.label: DataSeal homepage
refs.proves: '200+ people search sites and brokers', automated removal, virtual emails, $1M cover — and no price

refs.label: DataSeal: sites we cover (named list)
refs.proves: The official named list — 218 named site cards across 3 pages (100 + 100 + 18) under a '200+ sites' headline

refs.label: DataSeal FAQ
refs.proves: Dashboard shows sites in progress / completed removals / actively monitored for re-listing; continuous monitoring; no price, no Google-recrawl wording, no annual-upgrade wording in the current FAQ
